scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.check: node --check src/main.js && node --check src/hero-animation.js && node --check src/pbr-textures.js && node --check scripts/check-assets.mjs && node scripts/check-gameplay.mjs
scripts.assets:optimize:hero: gltf-transform optimize public/assets/models/hero-source.glb public/assets/models/hero.glb --compress quantize --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --simplify false
scripts.assets:optimize:guardian: gltf-transform optimize public/assets/models/guardian-source.glb public/assets/models/guardian.glb --compress quantize --texture-compress webp --texture-size 1024 --simplify false
scripts.assets:optimize:all: npm run assets:optimize:hero && npm run assets:optimize:guardian
